brief:
Britain's Home Secretary has banned clothes designer Mo Hamzeh, according to Middle East Eye. Hamzeh told the outlet he is the "latest victim" of what he characterizes as Britain's campaign against Palestinian activism. The designer's T-shirts carried slogans critical of Western support for Israel.

The ban represents an escalation in restrictions on speech related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in the UK. Hamzeh's case comes amid broader government scrutiny of pro-Palestinian expression and activism across the country.

title: UK bans clothes designer for pro-Palestinian T-shirt slogans
